# Town of Wolcott municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 28; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a selectboard
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): refers readers to the town's own roster for Wolcott
Town of Wolcott, Selectboard page (live, October 2026): Linda J. Martin (Chair), Michael Paradee (Vice Chair), Kurt Billings, Allen Carpenter, and Dolan Patrick

Town of Wolcott, FY2025 Town Report, officers table (published February 2026): Martin (Chair), Paradee (Vice Chair), Billings (to 2027), and Carpenter (to 2028) elected; the fifth seat was Richard Lee's (to 2027). Lee has departed and Dolan Patrick sits with no election record, so Patrick is minted as a vacancy appointee on this hybrid post (flagged). Martin's and Paradee's printed terms expired in 2026; both still chair the live board, so they are carried on incumbent-continuity (disclosed)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Belinda Harris Clegg as Wolcott's Town Clerk
Town of Wolcott, FY2025 Town Report, officers table (published February 2026): Town Clerk Belinda Harris Clegg, term to 2028
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Belinda Harris Clegg as Wolcott's Town Treasurer
Town of Wolcott, FY2025 Town Report, officers table (published February 2026): Town Treasurer Belinda Harris Clegg, term to 2028
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Wolcott, FY2025 Town Report, officers table (published February 2026): Moderator Joe Hester-Ingram, one-year term expiring 2026. The March 2026 outcome is unpublished, so no holder is minted; Hester-Ingram is carried as a straggler on issue #163
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers

Town of Wolcott, FY2025 Town Report, officers table (published February 2026): listers Thomas Martin (to 2028), Tracey LaPorte (to 2027), and W. Samuel Hill (expiring 2026). Hill's seat stood in 2026 with the outcome unpublished, so it is left unfilled and Hill is carried as a straggler on issue #163

Town of Wolcott, FY2025 Town Report, officers table (published February 2026): Cemetery Commissioners Crista Lowell (Chair, to 2028), Bradley Horstman (to 2027), and John Michael Green (to 2029); Lucien Gravel's seat expired in 2026 with the outcome unpublished and the fifth seat printed vacant, so both are left unfilled and Gravel is carried as a straggler on issue #163

Town of Wolcott, FY2025 Town Report, officers table (published February 2026): the report's own layout splits the Wolcott Public Library board into appointed trustees -- Charmone Lloyd (to 2030) and Jennifer Ward (to 2029), with a third appointed seat printed vacant -- and elected trustees Johanna Duff and Anne LeRiche, whose terms expired in 2026 with the outcomes unpublished. The two appointed trustees are minted on this hybrid post; the elected seats are left unfilled and Duff and LeRiche are carried as stragglers on issue #163
